evidence.method: Authorized read-only v2/order inspection; only warranty-related values retained. Sample identities and product names replaced.
evidence.pictured_item: The sole MacBook on the supplied shield/check screenshot was returned with Add protection plan.
evidence.contrast: A different order's two peripherals returned No protection plan; another order's cable and monitor returned null.
evidence.limitation: No upstream UI source or API documentation mapping the blue shield/check was available. These observations correlate the pictured item with protectionPlan; they do not prove the icon's rendering condition. The contrasting items were not independently checked in the upstream UI.
evidence.insurance: insuranceRequested was null on both the pictured item and all contrasting items. Do not substitute it for protectionPlan.
evidence.synthetic_cases: Specific named plans, mixed duplicates, malformed values, and normalized no-plan variants in tests are defensive synthetic cases, not additional observed upstream values.
